Nina S: Dropping a couple UI variants for the usage/billing dashboard. Two main forks: (A) inline-expansion rows where invoice details + token breakdown appear under the row, (B) modal/flyout detail panel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/usage-billing-variants Ethan R: I prefer flyout for long token timelines. Inline expansion is ok for short notes but will push table height a lot on mobile. Priya K: Analytics: most mobile users collapse by default. If we do inline expand, add a chevron affordance and remember state per user. Sam T: Heatmap idea: add a mini spend heatmap across projects at top of table. Color ramp needs to be colorblind-friendly. Suggest using palettes from our design tokens: --red-600 (hot), --blue-200 (cold) but test with simulate-colorblind. DesignPing: Accessibility nits: - Ensure heatmap cells have aria-label like "Project X: $12,345, change +8%" - Tooltip content must be reachable by keyboard (focusable cells) - Provide a text alternative summary above chart for screen readers Example snippet:
Nina S: CSV: what columns are essential in export? Current list is date, invoice_id, org_id, project_id, total_cost, token_count, token_breakdown. Thoughts on including per-route cost? Ethan R: Add per-route cost as optional column flagged in UI. Default export should stay minimal to keep file sizes small. Maybe a checkbox modal for additional columns. Priya K: Also include invoice-level notes field. Customer support uses it a lot. Sam T: Sorting: users want to sort by cost, but also by tokens per dollar (efficiency). Can we compute a derived column "tokens_per_$" and let it be a sort key? DesignPing: Visual: token badges need contrast ratio check. Current gray-on-light fails WCAG 2.1 AA for small text. Increase weight or darker bg. AnalyticsBot: Data: past 90 days - 64% of billing-page sessions click an invoice to view details; 27% then click into a project. Nina S: Decision leaning: flyout for full details (timeline + per-route) + keep compact inline token badges for quick glance. Heatmap at top, accessible legend, density toggle for table. We'll prototype interactions and A/B test flyout vs inline on a small subset. Ethan R: Microcopy suggestions: use "Download invoice (CSV)" and make export modal explain max rows and compression. Priya K: Action items: - Nina: prototype A variant (inline) + B variant (flyout) prototypes in Figma (by Mon) - Sam: prepare accessible color ramp and heatmap legend + contrast report (Wed) - Ethan: export modal copy + optional per-route column checkbox (Tue) - Priya: track experiment metrics: invoice_click, project_drill, export_with_routes (start of next sprint) DesignPing: Added a11y checklist to the design file. Nina S: Cool. Please react with :one: for inline-first, :two: for flyout-first so I can log the experiment config. Ethan R: :two: Priya K: :two: Sam T: :one: DesignPing: :two:
